title: sverify Substrait contract manifest
description: The `manifest` of the `io.sverify.substrait.v1.Contract` message that Report.to_substrait attaches to an exported plan (substrait_contract.proto), as protobuf's JSON form of its google.protobuf.Struct: every number is a double. Format 2: format 1 (before 1.0) said profile, observation and observation_components, which a reader maps. Within 1.x the manifest only gains optional keys, and readers ignore keys they do not know (docs/stability.md). docs/guide.md, "Exporting to Substrait", says what each key holds.

sverify.description: The version of sverify that exported the plan.

substrait.description: The Substrait version the plan is written for, as `major.minor.patch`.

semantics.description: The semantics the plan was verified under. 1.x may add values.

class.description: exact, observed (equal up to `equivalence`) or assumed (with annotated choices). 1.x may add values.

evidence.description: proved, or tested where IEEE 754's default rounding stands in for an option. 1.x may add values.

equivalence.description: What the postconditions can tell apart, as sv.equivalent prints it.

equivalence_components.description: The equivalence's components (rows, floats, ...), each as text.

rows.description: At most this many output rows, or null. An integer (protobuf's JSON may write it as 1000.0).

output.description: The output's columns with their Ibis types.

checker_contract.description: The checker's entries for the table conditions (keys, ensures_keys, references, max_rows, rows_per), which sv.from_substrait sends back to the checker.

rows.description: One object per option or gap, with at least the option's group or the gap.
